description: Sets how many hours before a class a member can cancel free, how many classes can be booked on an unpaid pack, how many days ahead members can book, and whether people still booked when a class ends count as attended automatically (otherwise the team marks each one). Only the fields you send change. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

attended_automatically_after_class.description: True (default): when a class ends, everyone not marked as no-show counts as attended. False: the team marks attendance; unmarked people stay booked.

name: set_booking_rules
title: Change booking rules
